slides.headline: Two jobs. One {pipeline}.
slides.sub: More enquiries and better follow-up are not the same fix.

slides.headline: Generate {demand}.
slides.sub: Meta campaigns put a relevant offer in front of the right people. Measure qualified enquiries, not just clicks.

slides.headline: Qualify {demand}.
slides.sub: After a person opts in, ask fit questions, route the enquiry and make the next step clear. AI calling is one option when consent and setup are right.

slides.headline: Fix the {bottleneck} first.
slides.sub: Thin pipeline? Review targeting and offer. Plenty of enquiries but few conversations? Review response and qualification.

slides.headline: Track every {handoff}.
slides.sub: Ad to opt-in. Opt-in to consent-appropriate follow-up. Qualification to a human sales meeting. Lead count alone does not tell you where the pipeline stalls.

slides.headline: Where does your pipeline {stall}?
slides.sub: DM MAP. Tell us whether it is traffic, enquiries or follow-up. We will identify the first bottleneck.
